description: One-sheet preliminary wiring model pairing a Siemens SIRIUS 3RM1201-1AA04 reversing starter with a source-backed SEW-EURODRIVE DRN63MS4 0.12 kW three-phase motor. Manufacturer pin identities and a 400 V star connection are represented. Starter, motor, protection, load and rotation behavior are not simulated; this example is not for construction.
